flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No report on tagging files sent to other agencies and SPMS or on tagging outcomes. Nearby: ocmsadminui pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx (LTA, MHA, VHUB tabs etc., none for tagging/SPMS); ocmsadminprivateapi AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl parsers only for MHA and LTA.
note: Story status is blank in stories.json; assessed from the story text. Because the tagging files to HDB, LTA, TP, NEA (OCMS33.8) and to SPMS (OCMS33.9) do not exist, a report on the records sent and the tagging outcomes (for example successfully tagged cases) does not exist either. No tagging outcome is received from any agency: the response parsers in AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl exist only for MHA and LTA (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:92-125); Toppan and vHub have their own parsers for their own files, not for tagging. The staff Report page has tabs for NOTICE-FE, RIP, NOTICE-CRE, LTA, VHUB, MHA, ENOTIF, HIVE_CONTACT, REMINDER, CPS, PS, DH_FIN, DH_UEN (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx:52-144); there is no tagging, CES, or SPMS tab. The per-agency reports (LTA, MHA, VHUB) show the pattern is reusable, but they are not counted. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim. Tagging reports for other agencies and SPMS are not built

steps.step: OCMS generates a report of the records sent to other agencies and SPMS
steps.detail: There is no outgoing tagging file, so no report for it. The staff Report page has tabs for NOTICE-FE, RIP, NOTICE-CRE, LTA, VHUB, MHA, ENOTIF, HIVE_CONTACT, REMINDER, CPS, PS, DH_FIN, DH_UEN (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx:52-144); there is no tagging, CES, or SPMS tab.

steps.step: OCMS receives the tagging outcomes from the agencies and SPMS
steps.detail: parseResponseFileContent, parseReportFileContent, and parseExceptionsFileContent handle only MHA and LTA, otherwise UnsupportedOperationException (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:92-125). No tagging outcome is received from HDB, TP, NEA, or SPMS.

steps.step: OCMS generates a report on tagging outcomes (for example successfully tagged cases)
steps.detail: There is no tagging outcome data and no report for it. There is no tagging/hitlist entity, repository, service, or screen in the six repos (grep for hitlist, tagging, tagged, SPMS, season parking returns nothing in source). The only leftovers are the commented-out 'Tagged Vehicle' route and menu (ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:326-329; ocmsadminui/src/utils/data/LinkData.tsx:406; ocmsadminui/src/utils/Meta/TaggedVehicle.ts:1-12) and a translation label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:167-169).

steps.step: The tagging officer downloads the reports from the staff portal
steps.detail: There is no tagging report to download. A Report page with download exists for other agencies, but not for the report the story names. The staff Report page has tabs for NOTICE-FE, RIP, NOTICE-CRE, LTA, VHUB, MHA, ENOTIF, HIVE_CONTACT, REMINDER, CPS, PS, DH_FIN, DH_UEN (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx:52-144); there is no tagging, CES, or SPMS tab. Same as OCMS33.7: not counted as Sebagian.
